PUBLIC COMMENTS
The public is encouraged to address the Planning Commission on items listed on this agenda on any matter posted on the agenda or on any other matter within its jurisdiction. If you wish to address the City Council or any of its Agencies, you may do so during the PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS period noted on the agenda. Each person is allowed three (3) minutes speaking time. A Spanish speaking interpreter is available for your convenience.
COMENTARIOS DEL PUBLICO
Se invita al público a dirigirse al Concilio o cualquiera otra de sus Agencias nombradas en esta agenda, para hablar sobre cualquier asunto publicado en la agenda o cualquier tema que esté bajo su jurisdicción. Si usted desea la oportunidad de dirigirse al Concilio o alguna de sus Agencias, podrá hacerlo durante el período de Comentarios del Público (Public Communications) anunciado en la agenda. A cada persona se le permite hablar por tres (3) minutos. Hay un intérprete para su conveniencia.
7:00 p.m. Council Chamber
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
Action Minutes from January 25, 2023
Action Minutes from February 8, 2023
STAFF REPORT
SET MATTERS - PUBLIC HEARINGS
1)
(THIS ITEM WAS CONTINUED FROM THE FEBRUARY 8, 2023, MEETING). Staff is requesting that this item be continued to a date uncertain to allow the applicant to
submit additional information to evaluate the project. Consideration to approve of a
conditional use permit to construct a double drive-thru lane and associated driving aisle,
landscaping, and utilities at an existing fast-food restaurant (McDonalds) located at 14008
Ramona Blvd.; Case Number CP 22-08:
a.
Conduct a public hearing.
b.
Find the proposed project is exempt from environmental review under the California
Environmental Quality Act (Pub. Resources Code, §§ 21000 et seq.) (“CEQA”) and the State
CEQA Guidelines (Cal. Code Regs, tit. 14, §§ 15000 et seq.). Specifically, the project is
categorically exempt from CEQA under Guidelines Section 15301 (Existing Facilities) as the
project consists of adding a double drive thru lane to an existing restaurant (McDonalds).
c.
Adopt Resolution PC 23-06 approving CP 22-08 "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING
COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK APPROVING A DOUBLE DRIVE
THRU LANE AT AN EXISTING RESTAURANT (MCDONALS'S) IN THE GENERAL
COMMERCIAL (C-2) ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLE 153.050.020 OF THE CITY'S
MUNICIPAL CODE. (LOCATION: 14008 RAMONA BLVD.; APPLICANT: TOM LE CASE NO. CP 22-08).
2)
(CONTINUED FROM THE FEBRUARY 8, 2023, PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING) Consideration to approve of a conditional use permit to allow an off-sale ABC
License Type 20 for beer and wine in conjunction with an existing convenience store/service
station (Mobil) located at 12670 Ramona Boulevard.; Case Number CP 22-12.
a.
Conduct a public hearing.
b.
Find the proposed project is exempt from environmental review under the California
Environmental Quality Act (Pub. Resources Code, §§ 21000 et seq.) (“CEQA”) and the State
CEQA Guidelines (Cal. Code Regs, tit. 14, §§ 15000 et seq.). Specifically, the project is
categorically exempt from CEQA under Guidelines Section 15301 (Existing Facilities) as the
project consists of adding an ABC Alcohol License Type 20 to an existing convenience store
and service station.
c.
Adopt Resolution PC 23-07 approving TPM 83824 “A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING
COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK APPROVING A TYPE 20 (OFF-SALE
BEER AND WINE) ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGE CONTROL (ABC) LICENSE IN
CONJUNCTION WITH AN EXISTING CONVENIENCE STORE AND SERVICE
STATION (MOBIL) IN THE GENERAL COMMERCIAL (C-2) ZONE, PURSUANT TO
TABLE 153.050.020 OF THE CITY’S MUNICIPAL CODE. (LOCATION: 12670 RAMONA
BLVD.; APPLICANT: HARJIT SIGH SAINI CASE NO. CP 22-12).
STAFF REPORT
3)
(CONTINUED FROM THE FEBRUARY 8, 2023, PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING) Consideration to approve a tentative parcel map to subdivide one lot into two
lots and to develop each lot with a primary dwelling unit with a detached Accessory Dwelling
unit at 4011 Harlan Avenue Case Number PM 83824:
a.
Conduct a public hearing.
b.
Find the proposed project is exempt from environmental review under the California
Environmental Quality Act (Pub. Resources Code, §§ 21000 et seq.) (“CEQA”) and the
State CEQA Guidelines (Cal. Code Regs, Title 14, §§ 15000 et seq.). Specifically, the
project is categorically exempt from CEQA under Guidelines Section 15315 (Minor
Land Divisions) because the project consists of a subdivision of one (1) lot into two (2)
lots.
c.
Adopt Resolution PC 23-05 approving TPM 83824 “A RESOLUTION OF THE
PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK APPROVING A
TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP TO SUBDIVIDE A 12,057-SQUARE FOOT PARCEL
INTO TWO (2) PARCELS WITHIN THE R-1, SINGLE FAMILY RESIDENTIAL
ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLE 152.040.030 OF THE CITY’S MUNICIPAL CODE
(LOCATION: 4011 HARLAN AVENUE).
STAFF REPORT
REPORTS OF OFFICERS (CONTINUED FROM THE FEBRUARY 8, 2023, PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING)
4)
Study Session: Objective Design Standards presentation.
5)
Election of Planning Commission Chair
6)
Election of Planning Commission Vice Chair
COMMISSION / STAFF COMMUNICATIONS
ADJOURNMENT
CERTIFICATION
I, Ron Garcia, Planning Commission Secretary hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.
PLEASE NOTE: Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to each item on this agenda are available for public viewing and inspection at City Hall, 14403 E. Pacific Avenue, 2nd Floor Lobby Area or at the Los Angeles County Public Library in the City of Baldwin Park, 4181 Baldwin Park Blvd. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the Planning Department at 626.813-5261 or via e-mail to rgarcia@baldwinpark.com
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the Public Works Department or Risk Management at 626.960.4011. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable staff to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting. (28 CFR 34.102.104 ADA TITLE II)
